name: Pagos
description:
The Pagos MCP Server connects your AI client to two powerful payment data sources: the Pagos BIN Database for payment card identification and issuer information, and your business' harmonized payments data for transaction event analysis and cost optimization.
With BIN queries, look up card brand, issuer, network, and card type information for any BIN number. With Pagos Data queries, analyze your payment performance across processors, geographies, and card types—asking questions like "What's my authorization rate for Visa transactions this month?" or "How much am I spending on interchange fees by processor?"
Pagos ingests data from all your payment processors, harmonizes it into a unified dataset, and makes it accessible through natural language queries in your preferred AI chat interface.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pagos to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pagos to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.pagos.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pagos MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pagos lists 14 MCP tools, including get_bin_data, hello, list_dispute_dimensions, list_dispute_metrics, list_fee_dimensions, list_fee_metrics, list_refund_dimensions, list_refund_metrics, list_transaction_dimensions, list_transaction_metrics, query_dispute_data, and query_fee_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pagos?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Pagos in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Pagos requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Pagos is developed by Pagos.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
